heading: Questions? We can read your mind

items.q: What is the B.Sc. in Economics and Data Analytics at ATLAS?
a: The B.Sc. (Hons.) in Economics & Data Analytics at ATLAS SkillTech University is a cutting-edge four-year undergraduate program that blends the analytical depth of economics with the technical precision of data analytics, empowering students to interpret real-world complexities through economic theory, quantitative tools and data-driven insights. Students learn to decode market trends, human behaviour and global developments using data visualisation, econometrics, coding and predictive modelling.

items.q: Is this a management program or a technology program?
a: It's neither purely one nor the other, it's an interdisciplinary program that sits at the intersection of both. It combines economic theory and policy thinking with technical tools like Python, R, SQL, Machine Learning and Big Data Analytics. It's best described as a quantitative economics and data science degree housed within a business school, ideal for students who want analytical and strategic careers, not pure coding or traditional management roles.

items.q: Does the program include hands-on training or internships?
a: Yes. The program includes live industry projects in areas like marketing strategy, market research and financial analysis; startup collaborations through Startup Street; field research and consumer surveys; and internships with agencies, corporates and investment firms. Each year also includes a credit-bearing Live Project / Summer Internship / Summer School component built into the curriculum.

items.q: What careers can I pursue after a B.Sc. in Economics and Data Analytics?
a: Graduates can pursue careers across Finance & Banking (Financial Analyst, Risk Analyst, Quantitative Researcher), Consulting & Strategy (Business Consultant, Policy Analyst, Economic Advisor), Data & Technology (Data Scientist, Machine Learning Analyst, Product Analyst), Public Policy & Development (Economist, Research Associate, Impact Evaluation Specialist) and Corporate & Market Research (Business Intelligence Analyst, Consumer Insights Manager).

items.q: Does this program support entrepreneurship and tech-based business ventures?
a: Yes. The B.Sc. in Economics and Data Analytics provides strong foundations in Python, Machine Learning, Big Data, AI and predictive analytics, alongside business and economic thinking. ATLAS ISME also offers an active entrepreneurship ecosystem with Startup Street, incubation support, mentorship and VC demo days, providing a solid launchpad for aspiring tech entrepreneurs to build data or AI-driven ventures.

items.q: What are the eligibility criteria for this B.Sc. in Economics and Data Analytics?
a: For Indian Boards (ISC/CBSE/State), a minimum of 60% overall in Class XII is required, with Mathematics as a mandatory subject. For A-Levels, minimum grades A, B or C in any 2 subjects are needed, plus a Grade B or above in Mathematics. For IB, a minimum of 24 points with 3 HL and 3 SL subjects is required, with Mathematics mandatory.

items.q: What are the top career opportunities after a B.Sc. in Economics and Data Analytics Degree from ATLAS ISME?
a: Graduates are well-positioned for high-growth roles including Data Scientist, Quantitative Analyst, Financial Analyst, Policy Analyst, Economic Advisor, Machine Learning Analyst, Business Intelligence Analyst, Product Analyst, Risk Analyst, Econometrician and Market Research Specialist — across corporates, consulting firms, fintech start-ups, government bodies and research institutions. The final year's focus on Advanced Econometrics, AI Applications and a Dissertation/Capstone Project further sharpens career readiness.
